reason: I have years of workout data in Strong and Hevy, and since MOV's core tracking and CSV import are free, I won't pay for Pro until I verify the import is seamless and the logging UI is fast enough between sets.
objection: I'm worried the social feed will be an empty ghost town without my friends, and that the interface will feel cluttered and slow down my gym logging.
would_change_my_mind: A completely seamless CSV import of my past lifting history, an ultra-fast and uncluttered in-gym logging experience, and my friends actively using the feed.
